text:
sarah-cs: FYI — Escalation from A-Smart Retail after release v2026.03.12 this morning. They report order item lists turning into single-line paragraphs and SKUs getting merged. Copying examples below.

A-Smart Retail: 'Prompt:
Order summary for order #8923:
- SKU: ASR-111
- SKU: ASR-112
Customer notes: deliver after 4pm.
Expected: bullet list with SKUs preserved.
Observed: "Order summary for order #8923: SKU ASR-111 SKU ASR-112 Customer notes: deliver after 4pm."'

jen-support: Can you ask for raw prompt logs, the exact model+version, and any request ids? We need the input payload and raw response body to repro.

dan-eng-ml: Also ask for model variant (e.g., redwood-3b-alpha standard vs optimized), runtime flags (quantization, max_tokens, temperature, top_p). If they have a request id we can pull server logs.

mike-se: Minimal repro ask: can they resend a single-shot prompt (no wrappers) that reproduces reliably? That rules out client-side postprocessing.

deploy-bot: rollout-manager: rollout completed v2026.03.12 build bld_20260312_0910 to production at 2026-03-12T09:10:00Z

dan-eng-ml: Please paste request id(s) if present (format: req_01Gx...). I'll grep logs for request_id and model metadata.

A-Smart Retail: Provided req ids: req_01Gx8nA0aB9 and req_01Gx8nA0aC0. Minimal prompt they used (triggers ~8/10 runs):
```
System: You are a summarizer.
User: Convert this order into a bulleted list preserving SKUs exactly as written:
Order #: 8923
Items:
- SKU: ASR-111
- SKU: ASR-112
Notes: deliver after 4pm
```
They pasted the raw API response body (redacted ids):
"{"id":"resp_...","choices":[{"text":"Order #8923:\n- SKU: ASR-111\n- SKU: ASR-112\nNotes: deliver after 4pm"}],"usage":{...}}"
They say their frontend shows it collapsed to a single line.

dan-eng-ml: I pulled server logs for those req ids: model=redwood-3b-alpha, variant=standard, quant=fp16, decode params: temperature=0.0, max_tokens=200, top_p=0.95. Server emission includes newlines and dashes; tokenization marks ASR-111 and ASR-112 as separate tokens.

mike-se: I ran a clean curl against hosted API with the same prompt and params — response preserved bullets and newlines. Low probability of server regression. Suggest customer-side renderer or client code collapsing markdown/newlines.

sarah-cs: Sent steps to customer: verify raw network response in dev tools, test in incognito/no renderer, try non-streaming and explicit temperature=0.0, and paste any UI code that formats the text.

alex-incident-manager: CASE-10234 opened and assigned to customer-success. Action items: 
- sarah-cs: collect client raw logs + screenshots (ETA 2h)
- dan-eng-ml: monitor the two req ids and compare with previous build if customer finds server repro (ETA 4h)
- mike-se: write short checklist to help customers distinguish server vs client formatting and attach to CASE-10234

eng-oncall: If customer still reproduces the collapse when running curl, ping me immediately and I will escalate.

sarah-cs: Ack :thumbsup:
